q: In a Rainwater Harvesting system, what is the primary function of the "First Flush" device?
o: To filter out bacteria and viruses
To divert the initial contaminated rainwater away from the storage tank
To measure the total volume of rainfall
To add chlorine automatically to the water
e: The first rain that falls on the roof washes away dust, bird droppings, and leaves. The "First Flush" device ensures this dirty water is discarded so it doesn't pollute the main storage tank.

q: In technical terms, "Garbage" specifically refers to which type of solid waste?
o: Putrescible (biodegradable) organic waste like food scraps
e: Garbage: Refers specifically to putrescible (easy to rot) biological waste like food, meat, and vegetables. Rubbish: Refers to non-putrescible waste (combustible like paper/wood, or non-combustible like glass/metal).

q: प्रदेश निजामती सेवाको सहायक पाँचौ तहमा बढुवा हुनको लागि एक तह मुनिको पदमा कति वर्ष सेवा अवधि पूरा गरेको हुनुपर्छ?
